origin.description: Lifts nonpositive eigenvalues by Higham's correction.

arguments.name: tol
arguments.text: Eigenvalues below 2*tol are lifted. The default follows the matrix size and the largest absolute eigenvalue.

origin.details: A non-square matrix raises an error. The correction is V diag(tau) V', with tau equal to the positive part of 2*tol minus each eigenvalue.
origin.value: A symmetric matrix of the same size.
